title: A filed flaky-check item shows test-seam pin guidance in its criteria
description: Run the real loop cycle against a real temporary Postgres control plane and scratch bare Git remote: when a merge trial fails a test once and passes its rerun, the filed Flaky check on main item on the running test install shows the test-seam pin guidance in its AC-1 criterion.

steps.name: Filed flaky-check item shows test-seam pin guidance in its criteria on a running test install
